what: Local Pooled Error-Based ANOVA for RNA-Seq Count Data
title: Local Pooled Error-Based ANOVA for RNA-Seq Count Data
text: LPEseq2 R package differential expression analysis RNA-seq count data using local pooled error-based ANOVA conventional one-way ANOVA. package provides functions preprocessing RNA-seq count data, estimating intensity-dependent variance trends, performing multi-group differential expression analysis. LPEseq2 supports LPE-ANOVA small-sample RNA-seq data, standard gene-wise one-way ANOVA larger sample sizes, automatic mode selects analysis method based group sample size.

code: install.packages("devtools") devtools::install_github("ldy0012/LPEseq2")

title: Local Pooled Error-Based ANOVA for RNA-Seq Count Data
text: LPEseq2 supports several normalization methods. basic use, library_size normalization can used without additional Bioconductor packages. TMM DESeq2 normalization, install following packages: upper-quantile regression-based variance trend estimation, install:
code: if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE)) {   install.packages("BiocManager") }  BiocManager::install(c("edgeR", "DESeq2")) install.packages("quantreg")

title: Local Pooled Error-Based ANOVA for RNA-Seq Count Data
text: Supported file formats: CSV (comma-separated), TSV (tab-separated), delimiter-separated text files (.txt). separator detected automatically. count matrix contain genes rows samples columns. first column must contain gene identifiers. sample metadata contain samples rows variables columns. column names count matrix must match row names colData.
code: # Example count matrix #        sample1 sample2 sample3 sample4 # gene1      100     120      80      95 # gene2       50      60      55      70 # Example colData #          group # sample1 Control # sample2 Control # sample3 Treatment # sample4 Treatment

title: Local Pooled Error-Based ANOVA for RNA-Seq Count Data
code: library(LPEseq2)  set.seed(123)  counts <- matrix(   rnbinom(1000, mu = 50, size = 10),   nrow = 100,   ncol = 10 )  rownames(counts) <- paste0("gene", 1:100) colnames(counts) <- paste0("sample", 1:10)  colData <- data.frame(   group = rep(c("Control", "Treatment"), each = 5),   row.names = colnames(counts) )  prep <- LPE_preprocess(   counts = counts,   colData = colData,   design = ~ group,   normalize.method = "library_size",   verbose = FALSE )  res <- LPE_ANOVA(   object = prep,   analysis.method = "auto",   standard.min.group.n = 5,   n.bin = 100,   df = 10,   use_weighted_between = FALSE,   p.method = "chisq",   verbose = FALSE )  head(res) attr(res, "analysis.method")

title: Local Pooled Error-Based ANOVA for RNA-Seq Count Data
text: iqr trimming method applies conventional 1.5 × IQR boxplot rule within expression-intensity -bins. Within-group -group-derived pairwise values pooled trimming, outliers detected M-value scale used variance trend estimation.
code: res_iqr <- LPE_ANOVA(   object = prep,   analysis.method = "LPE",   n.bin = 100,   df = 10,   trim.method = "iqr",   trend.method = "mean_spline",   use_weighted_between = TRUE,   p.method = "chisq",   verbose = FALSE )  head(res_iqr) attr(res_iqr, "trim.info") attr(res_iqr, "trend.info") attr(res_iqr, "base.var") attr(res_iqr, "var.spline")

title: Local Pooled Error-Based ANOVA for RNA-Seq Count Data
text: auto mode, LPEseq2 selects standard one-way ANOVA every group least standard.min.group.n samples. Otherwise, LPE-ANOVA used. default threshold : threshold practical heuristic. can adjusted depending study design expected reliability gene-wise variance estimation.
code: res_auto <- LPE_ANOVA(   object = prep,   analysis.method = "auto",   standard.min.group.n = 5,   n.bin = 100,   df = 10,   use_weighted_between = FALSE,   p.method = "chisq",   verbose = FALSE )  attr(res_auto, "analysis.method") standard.min.group.n = 5

title: Local Pooled Error-Based ANOVA for RNA-Seq Count Data
text: LPEseq2 supports boxplot/IQR-based outlier trimming pairwise values used variance trend estimation. trim.method = "iqr", LPEseq2 first pools within-group pairwise values -group-derived values. pooled values divided expression-intensity -bins, conventional boxplot rule applied within bin: Outlier detection performed M-value scale M scale used local pooled variance estimation. none method remove pairwise values variance trend estimation.
code: lower_bound = Q1 - 1.5 * IQR upper_bound = Q3 + 1.5 * IQR

title: Local Pooled Error-Based ANOVA for RNA-Seq Count Data
text: quantile regression method can used conservative variance trend desired. method estimates upper-quantile variance trend. may reduce potential variance underestimation high-variability genes, can also reduce statistical power. quantile regression fit used directly gene-wise variance prediction without secondary smoothing spline refitting. quantreg package required trend.method = "quantile_regression" used.
code: trend.method = "quantile_regression" tau = 0.75

title: Run LPE-ANOVA — LPE_ANOVA
text: Performs multi-group differential expression analysis using intensity-dependent local pooled error variance trend.

title: Run LPE-ANOVA — LPE_ANOVA
code: LPE_ANOVA(   object,   n.bin = 100,   df = 10,   trim.method = c("iqr", "none"),   trend.method = c("mean_spline", "quantile_regression"),   tau = 0.75,   use_weighted_between = FALSE,   analysis.method = c("LPE", "standard_anova", "auto"),   standard.min.group.n = 5,   verbose = TRUE,   p.method = c("chisq", "F_inf") )

title: Run LPE-ANOVA — LPE_ANOVA
text: object list returned LPE_preprocess(). n.bin Number quantile bins used variance trend estimation. df Degrees freedom smoothing spline. trim.method Outlier trimming method applied pairwise values used variance trend estimation. One "iqr" "none". "iqr" applies conventional 1.5*IQR boxplot rule within expression-intensity -bins pooling within-group -group values. "none" performs outlier trimming. trend.method Method used fit variance trend. One "mean_spline" "quantile_regression". "mean_spline" fits smoothing spline bin-level variance estimates. "quantile_regression" fits upper-quantile regression trend reduce potential variance underestimation. tau Quantile level used trend.method = "quantile_regression". Default 0.75. use_weighted_between Logical. Whether include weighted -group differences variance trend estimation. analysis.method Analysis method. One "LPE", "standard_anova", "auto". "LPE" uses local pooled error-based ANOVA. "standard_anova" uses conventional gene-wise one-way ANOVA. "auto" selects standard ANOVA groups least standard.min.group.n samples; otherwise, LPE-ANOVA used. standard.min.group.n Minimum per-group sample size required use standard one-way ANOVA analysis.method = "auto". verbose Logical. Whether print progress messages. p.method P-value calculation method. One "chisq" "F_inf".
